cli.label: Codex CLI
cli.interface_and_execution_location: Standalone Codex terminal client on a native Windows workstation. Workspace commands run locally; model inference is through OpenAI.
modes: Interactive CLI where needed to describe mode-specific capabilities
platforms: Native Windows 11 with PowerShell; sandbox behavior depends on the configured Windows implementation and device support
cli.account_and_tier: Proposed: ChatGPT Plus with ChatGPT sign-in; pending team confirmation. Tier-specific limits, model availability and enterprise-only controls are not generalized.
cli.model_support: OpenAI model availability depends on the account and configuration; no specific inference model is required for this documentary profile.
included_components: Native CLI workspace tools, AGENTS.md, exec mode, permission profiles, approval policy and native Windows sandbox options
exclusions: ChatGPT desktop app, IDE extension, cloud tasks, Work Cloud and WSL
Third-party MCP servers, plugins, external skills and custom providers
Experimental and enterprise-only controls unless the exact scope is agreed
cli.instructions_and_permissions: Document project instruction layering, permission profile and approval policy separately. Identify which Windows sandbox implementation a claim assumes.

modes: Interactive local desktop coding sessions; planning, approvals and other documented modes considered separately
platforms: Windows 11, native local execution; WSL and remote/cloud sessions excluded
app.account_and_tier: Proposed: ChatGPT Plus with ChatGPT sign-in; pending team confirmation. Tier-specific limits, model availability and enterprise-only controls are not generalized.
app.model_support: OpenAI model availability depends on the account and configuration; no specific inference model is required for this documentary profile.
included_components: Native project context, editing, command execution, review and permission controls
Native instruction, skill and MCP mechanisms only; no added connections
exclusions: CLI and IDE extensions as separate product surfaces
Cloud, SSH and WSL execution; consumer chat and non-coding modes
Added MCP servers, plugins, custom skills, external providers and enterprise administration
app.instructions_and_permissions: Assess app-specific modes, native local execution policy and documented shared configuration; never infer an OS sandbox from a Git worktree.
